title: Enterprise Support: Restoring suspended service
content:
Enterprise Support — Restoring suspended service.

## Policy clauses

The contract status is suspended.

The contract payment restriction status is clear.

Restore a suspended holding after its official payment restriction clears; no customer promise substitutes for recorded clearance.

Set status active.

Bill resumption fee under lifecycle fee accounting only when positive, and preserve retained-resource history.

A contract already active needs no write; a closed contract requires a new signed application and cannot be resumed.

## Authoritative evidence

The contract status is suspended. The authoritative system record must establish the condition before the action. Its evidence comprises support contract reference, status. Correlate the action to the same support contract reference.

The contract payment restriction status is clear. The authoritative system record must establish the condition before the action. Its evidence comprises support contract reference, payment restriction status. Correlate the action to the same support contract reference.
